name: Peco Streamline Code 100
description: Peco Streamline OO/HO Code 100 - flexible track and finer-geometry turnouts/crossings, intended for layouts that move beyond fixed Setrack geometry. Code 100 rail-foot is interchangeable with Setrack and Hornby OO via standard rail joiners (SL-10/SL-11). Streamline turnouts are 'small radius' (438 mm), 'medium radius' (~914 mm) and 'large radius' (~1524 mm). Flex track is 914 mm (36 in) nominal.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog.
